title: Quick-fill Malta expense planner
intro: A blank-by-default planner for 13–19 October 2026. Enter full trip/party amounts in euros (€) consistently; no flight, hotel, meal, fare, ticket, or reimbursement amount has been assumed. Bus and travel-card prices are now published and verified on the transport page if you want a benchmark for the transport rows; the only hotel-side figure with an official basis is the €1.50-per-night eco-contribution for guests aged 18+.

records.name: Flights — all travelers
records.address: Not applicable — editable expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the booked round-trip total, including baggage, seat selection, payment fees, and any changes. Departure airport, airline, traveler count, and booking price have not been provided; do not assume a U.S. gateway or flight itinerary.
records.notes: Malta Airport’s airline directory is for route/provider discovery, not a fare quote. Enter the total from the selected airline’s booking or receipt; if charged in USD, convert using the card/statement rate and note the conversion or fee.
records.price range: Not published; budget and actual fields start blank

records.name: AX ODYCY — full accommodation booking total
records.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the full booking total and note the confirmed check-in/out dates
records.description: Hotel and Deluxe Sea-View room are user-supplied trip details. No booking confirmation, price, deposit, meal plan, traveler count, or exact check-in/out time was supplied. Enter the confirmed booking total rather than multiplying an assumed nightly rate; do not infer the number of hotel nights from the travel window alone.
records.notes: Official AX ODYCY property page; it is not a quote or confirmation of this reservation. Record any included meals, deposit, cancellation terms, and separately billed hotel charges in the notes field.
records.price range: Not published; booking amount starts blank

records.name: Hotel taxes, environmental contribution, deposits, or other separately billed charges
records.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Optional line for charges shown separately on the confirmed hotel invoice. The Malta Tourism Authority’s guidelines confirm a contribution of €1.50 per night for each guest aged 18 or over from 1 July 2026, capped at €22.50 per person per visit and disclosed separately on the invoice. A six-night stay would therefore be €9.00 per eligible adult if all six nights are billable — a conditional calculation from the supplied dates, not the traveler’s confirmed amount. Do not duplicate amounts already included in the accommodation total.
records.notes: MTA’s published rate, age threshold, per-person cap and effective date were checked 11 Oct 2026. The MTA says the contribution must appear as a separate item on the invoice/fiscal receipt. Whether anything is due on this booking depends on actual billable nights, guest ages and the hotel’s invoice; see OQ-23 in docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md. No personalized amount has been prefilled. Re-read 11 October: MTA’s separate “15-Night Threshold” sentence is ambiguous alongside its rate/cap. Do not resolve that wording by inference; ask MTA/AX ODYCY for the charge on this booking (OQ-25). The six-night arithmetic is not a confirmed invoice or a determination of liability. Guidelines PDF read in full on 11 October 2026: https://mta.com.mt/docs/Eco-Contribution-Accommodation-Guidelines-2026.pdf . It confirms the €1.50 nightly rate, the 18+ age test at the start of the visit, the €22.50 per-person cap, that the cap corresponds to fifteen chargeable nights (explaining the “15-night” wording recorded as OQ-25), and that the amount must be shown separately on a fiscal receipt. The remaining open point is the invoice itself — billable nights and guest ages — so no amount is prefilled.
records.price range: €1.50 per person per night for guests aged 18+, maximum €22.50 per person per visit; six chargeable nights would be €9.00 per eligible adult. Not a confirmed charge — verify on the hotel invoice.

records.name: AX ODYCY ↔ BLAST Arena Studios event-day travel
records.address: From AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, to the confirmed MFCC/BLAST Arena Studios entrance
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the chosen event-day round-trip amount
records.description: Track the actual event-day commute separately from general bus spending. Route 186 is the strongest direct public-bus candidate found, but departure time, walk to the entrance, event end time, and post-event return are not settled. Enter the amount only after choosing the date-specific route or alternative.
records.notes: Official journey planner reference. The transport page records Route 186, an alternative Route 214, and a 17 October evening Route 186 diversion; recheck the planner/service alerts and event-day access details before budgeting or departing.
records.price range: Not set; exact date/time route and event return are not confirmed

records.name: Thunderpick event ticket / spectator access, if applicable
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta — the address on the event’s own ticketing listing.
records.hours: Wednesday 14 – Sunday 18 October 2026, 9:30 AM – 10 PM. Check-in 09:30 and games 10:30 on 14 and 15 October; check-in 14:00 and games 15:00 on 16 October. Ages 18+.
records.description: Free to attend, but still budget the hidden costs: a reservation is required, entry is 18+, and event days run later than the last bus, so a taxi or ride-hailing return is the realistic cost. Enter transport, food at the venue and any merchandise here; enter €0 for admission.
records.notes: Confirmed 11 October 2026 from the event’s official ticketing listing https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841 : organizer Hotspawn; venue BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard; Wednesday 14 – Sunday 18 October 2026, 9:30 AM – 10 PM; highlights “ages 18+” and “In person”; a free “Reserve a spot” action. Free ticketing is also reported by HLTV: https://www.hltv.org/news/45615/thunderpick-world-championship-talent-revealed . Organizer window and format: https://world-championship.thunderpick.io/2026-finals/ . Thunderpick release naming BLAST Studios Malta: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-returns-to-malta-with-1-million-prize-pool-302850221.html . Still open, so do not budget against them as settled: the Sat 17 and Sun 18 agenda entries, whether one ticket covers all five days, venue parking, and on-site food and drink. This row replaces an earlier version that said spectator access was unconfirmed and quoted a €10.00 precedent from a separate BLAST-run event.
records.price range: Free admission (“Free / Reserve a spot” on the listing). Budget the late-night return instead.
